title: Caret to claims slide tour
summary: A caret blinks on black, types a two-line capability claim, then the whole stage slides sideways to an image-editing card cluster and on to a second claim before a small wordmark. One continuous lateral move links features without cuts.
use_when: Demoing two or three AI capabilities in one continuous take, no hard cuts
Vertical social teaser where type carries most of the message and one UI moment proves it
Generative image or video tools that can show one output card with its prompt
Silent autoplay feeds: every claim is on screen long enough to read

look.type_style: geometric sans, regular weight, sentence case, centred two-line claims at ~2 % of frame height after reflow; trailing words of each claim in muted grey

sfx.event: each keystroke of the typed claim
lateral stage slide to the next feature

structure.shot: empty black frame with a thin text caret centred, blinking
structure.motion: caret on/off, about 0.5 s period (on at 0.00 and 0.77, off at 0.27 and 0.50; ±0.25 s), cut-on/cut-off, no easing

structure.shot: capability claim typed letter by letter at large size, wraps to two lines and shrinks as it fills; last word muted grey
structure.camera: pull-out: type scale ~1.00 -> 0.60 over 30 fr as the line reflows (motion.json -12.4 %/s; ±0.25 s)
structure.motion: typewriter ~14 chars/s with caret; size eases down with easings.outQuint ~24 fr (±0.25 s); muted tail word typed in grey

structure.shot: the finished two-line claim (4 words) holds centred on black
claim slides out left while a cluster enters from the right: tall illustrated image card, prompt text card lower left, two pill chips; second claim overlaid on the card
structure.camera: dolly left ~860 px/s @1920 (motion.json), whole stage moves as one plane
structure.motion: stage translate easings.outExpo ~24 fr, settles by 5.50 (±0.25 s); pills trail the card by ~1 cell (springs.ui, overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: cluster holds: image card centre, prompt card bottom left with keywords in bold, chips top right and mid right; claim (6 words) over the card, tail muted
structure.motion: hold with easings.linear creep; no element entrances

structure.shot: cluster whips out left in heavy blur; third claim (two lines, 6 words, second line muted) slides in from the right and holds centred
structure.camera: whip-pan left 7.50-8.77 with zoom 1.00 -> 1.10 (motion.json 10.3 %/s at 8-9 s), then push-in ~1.02 over 60 fr
structure.motion: exit easings.inExpo ~10 fr with motion blur (cell 7.77 fully blurred); entry easings.outExpo ~15 fr, settled at 8.77 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: small lowercase wordmark with a superscript tag, centred on black, holds to the end
structure.camera: dolly left (stage slide) 11.00-11.50, then static hold
structure.motion: claim exits left blurred at 11.00, wordmark slides in from the right, easings.outExpo ~10 fr, settled by 11.50 (±0.25 s); hold 45 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg, muted (claim tails), surface for cards, bg
params.content.claims: 3 capability claims, 4-6 words each, two lines; the last 1-3 words render muted
params.content.image: one generated output image for the hero card (portrait, ~0.7 aspect)
params.content.prompt: prompt text shown on the lower card, 30-40 words, 3 keywords bold
params.content.chips: two short action labels for the pill chips (2 words each)
params.timing.caretHold: frames of the blinking caret before typing (default 30)
params.timing.slide: frames of each lateral stage move (default 24)

notes: Zero cuts in 13 s: every change is a lateral move of the whole stage. Motion.json pan peaks: -863 px/s (4-5 s), -398/-535 px/s (7-9 s), and a degenerate fit at 11-12 s (blurred exit). Claims shrink while typing (reflow from one big line to two small ones). Catalogue hinted prompt-typing; no prompt bar is typed or submitted in the sheets, so it is not tagged. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed term muted-tail (see recipe.md).
